setups.title: ALGO eyes upside
setups.technical_analysis: ALGO is trading above its EMA9 (0.09615) and EMA21 (0.09483), indicating short‑term bullish bias. MACD line sits just above its signal, producing a modest positive histogram. Stochastic is in the high‑70s, showing momentum but also a hint of overbought pressure.
setups.market_context: BTC is up about 5.6% in the past 24 h and the overall market breadth is broadly positive, supporting risk‑on sentiment.
